notes: Redrawn 2026-10-17 from the image geometry (gridded zoom of frame_sf.jpg and three frames at 16 s, 301 s, 751 s). right: the parking lane along the right curb of Broadway. The kerb-side car's box bottom (grey SUV, x 1480-1760, bottom y 656 at x 1566) sets the line; it runs parallel to the double yellow centre line (slope 40 px over 469 px). Strip from 18 px behind to 18 px in front of that line, about half a car width (the car one lane out, black sedan, has its bottom 33 px lower at x 1770). The old strip ran 30 px further out and reached the next travel lane, and its top edge was below the kerb-side car's bottom. left: removed. The old left strip covered the corner footway with the no-left-turn sign and the crosswalk; the curb lane of Columbus behind it is the stop-line approach (cars queue there at the red light), so there is no kerb-side parking strip on that side in view. Legality is unknown: no parking regulation was checked. Occupancy is position-based (parked.py).
